title: ZAPS: Zero-Cost Active Proxy Search for Neural Architecture Search
abstract: arXiv:2609.14184v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) automates network design, but evaluating a single candidate requires training it to convergence, making exhaustive search intractable. Zero-cost proxies estimate architecture quality at initialization in seconds, yet a single proxy is noisy, and combining several does not straightforwardly help: proxies are strongly correlated, so naive aggregation compounds their shared errors instead of averaging them out. Existing methods exploit either proxy signals or architectural topology - never both within a single active-learning framework. We introduce ZAPS (Zero-cost Active Proxy Search), a four-stage pipeline that closes this gap. translated_title: ZAPS：面向神经架构搜索的零成本主动代理搜索
translated_abstract: 神经架构搜索（NAS）实现了网络设计的自动化，但评估单个候选架构需要将其训练至收敛，这使得穷举搜索难以实现。零成本代理方法可以在几秒钟内估计架构在初始化时的质量，然而单一代理噪声较大，而简单组合多个代理也并不能直接带来帮助：由于代理之间高度相关，朴素的聚合方式会累积它们共同的误差，而不是将误差平均化。现有方法要么利用代理信号，要么利用架构拓扑结构，从未在单一主动学习框架内同时利用两者。我们提出了ZAPS（零成本主动代理搜索），这是一个弥补该空白的四阶段流水线。ZAPS（i）通过ProxyFit——一种贪婪的反冗余准则——离线选择一个紧凑且非冗余的代理子集；（ii）采用兼顾利用与探索的混合K-means策略初始化搜索；（iii）在每次迭代中通过自举投票重新选择代理……
tldr: 提出ZAPS四阶段框架，首次在单一主动学习框架中同时利用零成本代理信号与架构拓扑，通过ProxyFit反冗余代理选择、混合K-means初始化及迭代自举投票重选代理机制，实现高效且噪声可控的神经架构搜索。
en_tdlr: ZAPS is a four-stage active learning framework that, for the first time, jointly exploits zero-cost proxy signals and architectural topology within one pipeline, using ProxyFit anti-redundancy proxy selection, hybrid K-means seeding, and iterative bootstrapped proxy re-selection to enable efficient and robust neural architecture search.
